request_text: My surname is spelled wrong on the account. Please correct it - I am not asking you to delete or erase anything.
Bitte löschen Sie mein Konto und alle damit verbundenen personenbezogenen Daten, auch Einträge unter meiner früheren E-Mail-Adresse.
Please delete my account and anything still linked to my old phone number.
Peço a eliminação definitiva da minha conta e dos dados pessoais associados.
Please delete me from your newsletter and promotional mailing lists only. Keep my account open.
